summary: Executed backend API regression (pytest) and frontend Playwright integration checks for Lumina navigation, Studio filters, affiliate tracking, and lead forms. Backend APIs are healthy, but frontend-to-backend lead/affiliate integration fails on current preview URL due to API base URL wiring.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking Studio Check Price triggers /api/affiliate-click request that returns 404 on frontend preview URL, so tracking does not persist from UI path.
Consultation form POST /api/leads/consultation returns 404 from frontend runtime; success state never appears.
Contact form POST /api/leads/contact returns 404 from frontend runtime; success state never appears.

issues: Brand text and first nav item appear visually merged as 'LuminaHome' at a glance, reducing scan clarity.

action_items: Fix frontend API base URL usage in monetization service to use env-driven backend URL (per spec: process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) instead of relative '/api' only.
Add/restore frontend .env with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL for preview/prod parity.
Retest affiliate click and both lead forms from UI after API base URL fix.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/services/monetizationService.ts violates environment URL guideline by hardcoding relative API paths; this is the root cause of 404 integration failures in current runtime.
Required protected env key frontend/.env: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is missing in this workspace.
Backend currently stores events in process memory only; metrics/leads reset on restart (acceptable for MVP but should be persisted for monetization analytics).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_* payloads through API tests for affiliate click and lead submissions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints pass when called directly on backend host. Frontend integrations fail with 404 on /api/* from current preview host. Start with fixing frontend API base URL resolution and then rerun Playwright flows for affiliate + services + contact success states.
rca of the issue: RCA: Frontend monetization service uses relative endpoints ('/api/...') and does not consume REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. In this preview runtime, frontend host does not route /api to backend, so UI requests return 404. Repro: open /#/services or /#/contact, submit valid form -> network POST /api/leads/* returns 404 -> only error message shows. Similar in Studio: click Check Price -> /api/affiliate-click returns 404 and metrics are not updated from click path. Mitigation: wire API client to env-configured backend URL and ensure env key exists in frontend runtime.
